title: Privacy policy
lead: In short: the site has no registration, cookies, advertising or tracking (analytics) code. The data you enter is stored only on your device. We only receive a message that you yourself sent with the «Send» button.

sections.h: 1. Who is responsible for the data
sections.p: Data controller: {controller}. For questions, requests or to delete your data, write on Telegram: {telegram}.

Your plan, profile analysis answers, saved universities, calculator figures, letter and message drafts and settings are stored in your browser's local storage (localStorage). They are not sent to us or anyone else.

You can delete them at any time: Settings → «Delete all my data».

Only if you send it yourself: the «Feedback» form, a profile analysis result or a plan request.

Contents: the text you wrote; contact details (Telegram or phone) only if you enter them; technical information: site version, date, device type and browser (for example «Android · Chrome»), language and the page open.

Purpose: to answer your question and fix errors on the site. Legal basis: the answer you requested and the consent you give by sending (GDPR 6(1)(a) and 6(1)(b)).

Your message is delivered to the site owner's Telegram chat via a Cloudflare Worker. The Worker does not store the message, it only forwards it. Telegram stores messages on its servers.

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages: for security purposes GitHub may briefly log visitors' IP addresses.

These companies also operate outside the European Union and follow their own privacy policies (links below).

sections.h: 5. External services that work only when you click
sections.p:
Calendar subscriptions (Google, Apple, Outlook), videos (YouTube, Vimeo) and Telegram links connect to those services only after you click. After that, the service's own rules apply.

Fonts and images are loaded from the site itself.
Messages received on Telegram are deleted once your question is resolved and kept for at most 12 months. Only you control the data on your device.

You can ask us to show, correct or delete data about you and withdraw your consent. To do so, write to {telegram}; we reply within 30 days.

If you are in the European Union, you have the right to complain to the Italian data protection authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali).
If you are under 14, talk to your parents before sending us a message.
If this policy changes, it will be announced on this page with a new date.
